npcs:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original 2D top-down RPG NPC idle animation sprite sheet.
Use the reference image only for the 35-degree elevated camera, clean painted pixel-art inspired shading, muted palette and humanoid scale. Design THREE DISTINCT adult village NPCs, not copies or recolors of the hero.
EXACT 4-column by 3-row grid, twelve isolated full-body sprites, equal square cells with 12% safe transparent margins. All face slightly toward the viewer so face and role are readable. No written labels/grid, no environment, no floor, no aura or shadow; real transparent background.
Row1: village elder, thin elderly man with white hair in small topknot and long white beard, sage-green long outer robe, ivory inner collar, simple dark wooden walking staff and folded scroll. Four quiet idle poses: reading scroll, eyes glance up, hand/staff settles, return to reading. Same anatomy/feet/head scale, small real arm/fabric variations.
Row2: female herbalist, adult woman with dark braided hair pinned up, warm ivory blouse and muted dark teal skirt/apron, brown herb satchel, holding small herb sprig. Four idle poses inspecting sprig, shifting fingers, looking toward visitor, returning. Distinct face and silhouette, practical ancient dress.
Row3: village guard captain, adult man with tied black hair, dark moss/navy lamellar cuirass, muted oxblood shoulder scarf, pale trousers and dark boots, long straight spear held in right hand. Four quiet ready/weight-settling poses with minor elbow/spear and scarf motion. No Western plate armor or helmet.
Retain consistent face and limb lengths for each NPC, grounded feet aligned in each row. About 3.5 heads tall, readable torso and legs, restrained detail that survives 64x64 export. No big chibi heads. Clean alpha empty space between every sprite.
creatures:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production 2D ARPG monster animation sheet, transparent background.
Reference image is STYLE ONLY: same readable painted pixel-art inspired edges and muted ancient fantasy palette. No humans in this output.
Create an EXACT 6-column by 3-row regular grid of EIGHTEEN complete creature sprites, generous empty transparent safe margins, equal square cells. Camera elevated 35 degrees, creatures facing diagonally down-left; stable size/anatomy within each row. Rows are genuinely different silhouettes:
ROW1 forest gray wolf: lean quadruped, pointed ears, gray-brown fur and lighter muzzle, small amber eyes, no armor.
ROW2 jade forest viper: long muscular moss-green snake with pale underside, small angular head, coiled S body, no legs or human face.
ROW3 Lang Vương boss: much more massive old charcoal wolf, powerful shoulders, shaggy pale silver mane, scar over one eye and one small broken antler-like jade horn as its distinctive spirit mark; still clearly quadruped. Not a simple recolored gray wolf.
Columns1–4 are four actual articulated locomotion poses: wolves alternate fore/hind legs in walking gait with hip/shoulder rhythm and tail follow-through; snake's S-shaped coil advances in four distinct phases. Column5 attack anticipation: wolves crouch, head low, jaws prepare; snake rises into strike coil. Column6 attack: wolves leap forward and snap open jaws, snake extends neck forward to bite. Keep all limbs, tail and snout inside cell. No whole-image bobbing or stretched copies. No blood.
Transparent alpha everywhere outside each isolated animal. No floor, shadows, scenery, text, frame labels, grid or VFX. Keep light from upper-left, colors subdued and form readable when exported at 64x64.
ground:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original seamless ground material swatch atlas for a top-down ancient cultivation RPG. Reference image supplies muted natural palette and painted pixel-art inspired texture style only.
One square image divided into EXACTLY four equal square quadrants, no gutters or labels. Every quadrant completely filled edge to edge by its own material, seen straight from above with NO perspective, no horizon, no objects. Each quadrant is its own seamless tile that can repeat in both directions; keep frequency/scale consistent.
TOP LEFT: quiet mossy green meadow grass with scattered darker blades and very few tiny pale dry leaves, subdued olive/jade range, fairly uniform calm background, NO bushes or flowers.
TOP RIGHT: warm gray irregular old small paving stones with a little moss in joints, worn natural edges, moderate simple stone sizes, no straight brick-grid pattern.
BOTTOM LEFT: packed warm brown earth footpath with soft fine grit, occasional tiny pebble and dry leaf, low contrast, no large stones.
BOTTOM RIGHT: calm shallow muted teal-green stream surface, soft irregular small water ripples, a few submerged stones visible subtly, NO shore or bank, no bright turquoise stripes.
All four are intentionally calm game backgrounds so characters and combat signals read clearly. Consistent soft upper-left daylight, restrained color and texture density, no heavy noise. Opaque atlas, no transparency. No houses, trees, characters, shadows, UI, words, decoration or border.
fox:

Use attached monster sheet only for matching elevated 35-degree camera and painted pixel-art style. Readable fox anatomy, no wolf mane or horn, no human traits.

Sixth frame springs forward jaws open with legs extending. Keep consistent size and facial design. Each full fox including whole tail stays inside its own cell with 12% safe margin.
Fully transparent background, no floor/shadow, no aura, no glow or attacks, no text, no labels or grid. Muted warm fox coat with ivory underbelly, softly lit upper-left, crisp readable small-game silhouettes.
